verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt at docs.capacities.io/llms.txt (HTTP 200) that describes the Capacities documentation. The docs are also served as raw Markdown under /raw/*.md paths, which an agent can ingest directly. A machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0 spec is linked from the developer docs, adding agent-consumable API documentation. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents successfully using the llms.txt/raw docs, and evidence of an llms-full.txt or explicit agent-usage guidance.
